featured_reviews.name: Mudassir Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
National Market Wadala is one of the well-known local shopping destinations in Mumbai. The market is popular among residents because it offers a wide variety of products at affordable prices. From clothing and footwear to household items, accessories, and daily-use goods, shoppers can find almost everything in one place. The market is especially busy during weekends and festive seasons when many people come to explore the latest fashion trends and bargain deals.

One of the best things about National Market Wadala is its lively atmosphere. Small shops and street vendors create a vibrant environment that reflects the true spirit of local Mumbai markets. Many shopkeepers are friendly and ready to negotiate prices, which makes shopping more interesting and budget-friendly for customers.

The market is also conveniently located and easily accessible by road and public transport, making it a convenient spot for nearby residents and visitors. Food stalls around the market add to the experience, offering quick snacks and refreshments after shopping.

Overall, National Market Wadala is a great place for affordable shopping, exploring local culture, and enjoying the energetic vibe of a traditional Mumbai market.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya
featured_reviews.review_text:
The customer service provided by the entire staff was very appreciable that i feel i can rate this store 10 stars out of 5. The entire team was very friendly right from the point we entered the store. They were taking care of our requirements. Also the billing was done smoothly. Appreciate the manager and the entire staff for completing the billing and other formalities even after their working hours were over. It did not end up here at the point of billing but the team made sure we reach safely till the elevator for parking and helped carrying the heavy luggage.
I am always a Pantaloons fan and a 5 star member for a while. But i would highly recommend this store of Pantaloons at Kurla Phoenix Market City, Mumbai. It would be unfair if I dont mention Maqsood's name here. Thanks for your patience throughout our shopping. Looking forward to visit you guys again.

featured_reviews.name: Sana Solkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review out of sheer frustration and disappointment with the level of customer service at Pantaloons. It’s truly disheartening to see such a well-known brand hiring staff who are clearly not trained to handle customers properly.

Recently, I visited one of your stores to purchase some clothes. The sales staff were extremely pushy, practically forcing me to buy items rather than genuinely helping me find what I needed. It felt more like pressure than assistance, which is unacceptable.

To make matters worse, I am flying to Dubai this evening and needed urgent help. I called your customer care and was assisted by someone named Sanjana—without a doubt, the most unprofessional and unhelpful experience I’ve had with any brand. She had no active listening skills, showed zero empathy, and gave me an invalid store contact number. I’ve since spent a frustrating amount of time trying to reach the store manager, with no success. Calls get dropped or ignored, and no one takes accountability.

This kind of treatment towards paying, loyal customers is completely unacceptable. If this is the standard Pantaloons is setting, it's deeply disappointing. Your team leaves customers hanging and adds stress instead of solving problems.

I hope this review is taken seriously and that immediate steps are taken to improve customer service—starting with better training and accountability.

featured_reviews.name: aditya kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is named rareism for a reason. Visited Rareism and wow — everything truly lived up to the name.
Rare designs, rare assistance, and rare customer etiquette.
Basically, rarity everywhere, except the bill, which arrived instantly and was very much present.

The clothes looked trendy, but finding something worth buying felt like spotting a rare species in the wild. Staff behaviour? Let’s just say basic courtesy seems to be an endangered trait here. I spent more time waiting for someone to acknowledge my existence than I did browsing.

I guess the brand philosophy is:
Style – Rare.
Help – Rarer.
Smiles – Extinct.

If you’re into treasure hunts with no treasure, you’ll love this place.

featured_reviews.review_text: Clothes are good. Affordable. Haven't tried many makeup products but their juicy shine lip gloss—the one in the tube is not what you should buy. featured_reviews.name: Munawar Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience at Zudio Kurla store.

I purchased one pair of shoes that were kept together as a set. I tried only the left shoe, which fit perfectly. During billing, one of the executives checked and found that the shoe sizes were different—one was size 40 and the other was size 41.

The payment was already completed, so they asked me to go to the exchange counter. The staff searched for the correct size, but the same size was not available anywhere in the store. It was clearly a mistake, as two different sizes were kept together.

Eventually, they refunded my money, but the main issue is that I wasted almost 2 hours because of this mistake.

Suggestion: Please ensure shoe sizes are properly checked and matched before billing to avoid wasting customers’ time.
